# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C2, despot diplomacy (N3). Generated by gen_despot_diplomacy.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly: the main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly calls it (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES row 13 "dsp").
oe_dsp_monthly = {
    # 1. The interregnum has begun: the window of .1 opens (24 months). If Serbia's ruler is already our despot, .1 is
    #    done; on a game loaded after the interregnum had already ended, it is void.
    if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_begun NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_ank_m } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_ank_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_ank_end value = oe_ml_month_now } change_variable = { name = oe_dsp_ank_end add = 24 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_done_1 value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_guest value = c:SER }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ivr_done } set_variable = oe_dsp_void_1 }
    }
    # 2. The window of .1 has passed without it.
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_dsp_ank_end
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_done_1 }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_void_1 }
            var:oe_dsp_ank_end < oe_ml_month_now
        }
        set_variable = oe_dsp_void_1
    }
    # 3. Every quarter: note the reigning despots, find their successors.
    if = { limit = { OR = { current_month = 1 current_month = 4 current_month = 7 current_month = 10 } } oe_dsp_scan = yes }
    # 4. One event at most, in a month free of other main-line events, 6 months after the last: try one in this order.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_cd } oe_ml_free = yes oe_dsp_on = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_dsp_want_1 = yes } random = { chance = 35 oe_dsp_fire_1 = yes } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_dsp_want_3 = yes } random = { chance = 25 oe_dsp_fire_3 = yes } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_dsp_want_4 = yes } random = { chance = 20 oe_dsp_fire_4 = yes } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_dsp_want_2 = yes } random = { chance = 4 oe_dsp_fire_2 = yes } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, every quarter (and the test button dspscan). A dignity is the ruler's for life and lapses with the ruler
# (oe_tw_on_ruler_death), so a country whose recorded despot no longer reigns has a new ruler without the title:
#   the ruler holds Despot      -> var oe_dsp_hold = the ruler; a waiting confirmation is settled;
#   recorded, a new ruler       -> oe_dsp_prev = the old despot, oe_dsp_succ, .3 possible from 12 to 60 months on;
#   waiting too long            -> the confirmation lapses (with the exception mark).
oe_dsp_scan = {
    every_country = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { tag = BYZ }
            OR = { has_variable = oe_dsp_hold has_variable = oe_dsp_succ ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } }
            ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_dsp_sr }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_hold value = scope:oe_dsp_sr }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_prev } remove_variable = oe_dsp_prev } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_resk } remove_variable = oe_dsp_resk }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_hold has_ruler = yes }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_prev value = var:oe_dsp_hold }
            remove_variable = oe_dsp_hold
            set_variable = oe_dsp_succ
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_from value = oe_ml_month_now } change_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_from add = 12 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_until value = oe_ml_month_now } change_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_until add = 60 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_resk } remove_variable = oe_dsp_resk }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } var:oe_dsp_succ_until < oe_ml_month_now } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_prev } remove_variable = oe_dsp_prev } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_resk } remove_variable = oe_dsp_resk }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_exc } remove_variable = oe_dsp_exc }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_dsp.1: Serbia when eligible, else a Balkan Orthodox son under or at war with the Ottomans, saved as scope:oe_dsp_pk (none = nothing saved).
oe_dsp_pick_1 = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SER c:SER = { oe_dsp_visit_ok = yes } } c:SER = { save_scope_as = oe_dsp_pk } }
    else_if = {
        limit = { any_country = { oe_dsp_visit_ok = yes oe_dsp_ott_pressed = yes } }
        random_country = { limit = { oe_dsp_visit_ok = yes oe_dsp_ott_pressed = yes } save_scope_as = oe_dsp_pk }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Sends oe_dsp.1 to scope:oe_dsp_pk and starts the line's pause.
oe_dsp_send_1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_t value = scope:oe_dsp_pk }
    set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_cd months = 6 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dsp.1
}
# BYZ scope. Picks and sends oe_dsp.1; nothing when there is no one to pick.
oe_dsp_fire_1 = { oe_dsp_pick_1 = yes if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } oe_dsp_send_1 = yes } }

# BYZ scope. oe_dsp.4: an AI despot of ours, one with oe_dsp_bond first, saved as scope:oe_dsp_pk (none = nothing saved).

    if = {

# BYZ scope; var:oe_dsp_t = the country. Confers dignity $t$ (despotes, sebastokrator, kaisar, protosebastos) on its
# ruler with the dignity system's own effect oe_tw_grant_$t$ (price, opinion, cooldown, notice oe_tw.3). A target the
# player has open in the dignity dialog (var oe_tw_grant_target) is kept and put back. A new despot is recorded at once
# (var oe_dsp_hold), so a death before the next quarterly scan still brings .3. The caller removes var:oe_dsp_t.
oe_dsp_confer = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tw_grant_target } set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_saved_gt value = var:oe_tw_grant_target } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = var:oe_dsp_t }
        oe_tw_grant_$t$ = yes
        remove_variable = oe_tw_grant_target
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_saved_gt } set_variable = { name = oe_tw_grant_target value = var:oe_dsp_saved_gt } remove_variable = oe_dsp_saved_gt }
        var:oe_dsp_t = {
            if = {
                limit = { ruler ?= { has_character_modifier = oe_tw_title_despotes } }
                ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_dsp_sr }
                set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_hold value = scope:oe_dsp_sr }
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- option effects (BYZ scope; var:oe_dsp_t = the country)

}

# .2 b: despot as an exception, 4 more authority; the envoys' gift changes hands.
oe_dsp_opt_2b = {
    oe_dsp_confer = { t = despotes }
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -4 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } }
    add_gold = { value = var:oe_dsp_fee_v }
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= {
        add_gold = { value = var:oe_dsp_pay multiply = -1 }
        set_variable = oe_dsp_exc
        set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_bond years = 20 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}
# .3 a: the crown for the successor at half price (the system's price, then a refund; no authority back after an
# exception).
oe_dsp_opt_3a = {
    oe_dsp_confer = { t = despotes }
    add_prestige = 10
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_dsp_t ?= { oe_dsp_exc_applies = yes } } } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = 4 } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } }
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= {
        set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_bond years = 20 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_prev } remove_variable = oe_dsp_prev } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_resk } remove_variable = oe_dsp_resk }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}
# .3 b: wait and see (once): asked again in 24 months, the deadline at least 36 months away.
oe_dsp_opt_3b = {
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= {
        set_variable = oe_dsp_resk
        set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_from value = oe_ml_month_now } change_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_from add = 24 }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } var:oe_dsp_succ_until < oe_dsp_month_plus36 } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_until value = oe_dsp_month_plus36 }
        }
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_dsp_delayed target = c:BYZ }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}
# .3 c: no more.
oe_dsp_opt_3c = {
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= {
        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_dsp_snub target = c:BYZ }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_from } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } remove_variable = oe_dsp_succ_until } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_prev } remove_variable = oe_dsp_prev } if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_resk } remove_variable = oe_dsp_resk }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_exc } remove_variable = oe_dsp_exc }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}
# .4 a: accept the gift; the walls of Constantinople.
oe_dsp_opt_4a = {
    add_gold = { value = var:oe_dsp_gift_v }
    set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_gift_got value = var:oe_dsp_gift_v }
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= { add_gold = { value = var:oe_dsp_pay multiply = -1 } }
    location:constantinople = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_dsp_walls_inscription years = 20 mode = replace } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}
# .4 b: decline it.
oe_dsp_opt_4b = {
    add_prestige = 3
    var:oe_dsp_t ?= { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_dsp_thanked target = c:BYZ } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev page, BYZ scope)
# .1 without its window and roll; the guest rules as in play.
oe_dsp_test_1 = {
    oe_dsp_pick_1 = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } oe_dsp_send_1 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_dsp test 1: no eligible guest" }
}
# .2: the lord of Ioannina, or else any eligible lord in northern Greece or Albania.
oe_dsp_test_2 = {
    oe_dsp_pick_2 = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } } random_country = { limit = { oe_dsp_ioa_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_dsp_pk } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } oe_dsp_send_2 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_dsp test 2: no eligible lord" }
}
# .3: every waiting successor may ask from this month (twgrant, dspscan, twkill, dspscan first).
oe_dsp_test_3 = {
    every_country = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_succ } set_variable = { name = oe_dsp_succ_from value = oe_ml_month_now } }
    oe_dsp_pick_3 = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } oe_dsp_send_3 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_dsp test 3: no successor waiting" }
}
# .4 without the war or debt condition; still an AI despot of ours.
oe_dsp_test_4 = {
    oe_dsp_pick_4 = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_dsp_pk } oe_dsp_send_4 = yes }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_dsp test 4: no AI despot who would give" }
}
# Clears the line's pauses and done marks on BYZ.
oe_dsp_test_reset = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_cd } remove_variable = oe_dsp_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_done_1 } remove_variable = oe_dsp_done_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_void_1 } remove_variable = oe_dsp_void_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_ioa_cd } remove_variable = oe_dsp_ioa_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_n_ioa } remove_variable = oe_dsp_n_ioa }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_gift_cd } remove_variable = oe_dsp_gift_cd }
}
